title: Tool and Rental Return Deadline Watch
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:material rental_item=yes return_due_epoch=*
| eval days_left=round((return_due_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where returned!="yes"
| sort days_left
description: Lists rented tools or equipment that need to be returned soon to avoid extra charges.
value: Rental overrun fees are pure waste and usually happen because deadlines disappear into project noise.
implementation: Store return deadlines on rented materials and sort open items by days remaining.
visualization: Table of rental items by days until return deadline.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which rented tools need to go back soon before they start costing extra money.
